sources.title: Android 17 is here
sources.fact: Android 17 was released in June 2026 and is the current platform compatibility baseline.
sources.impact: Compile and compatibility test against API 37; do not assume target policy without checking Play requirements.
sources.refresh: Before every release or Android QPR compatibility cycle.

sources.title: React Native Releases Overview
sources.fact: React Native 0.86.x is an active stable series on 2026-08-05; 0.87 stable is scheduled for 2026-08-10 and is not yet the production baseline.
sources.impact: Pin 0.86.x for initial implementation and reevaluate after 0.87 stabilizes with native dependency compatibility.
sources.refresh: Before repository bootstrap and every RN upgrade.

sources.title: Meet Google Play target API level requirement
sources.fact: New apps and updates must target Android 16/API 36 or higher under the published 2026 requirement.
sources.impact: Initial targetSdk 36; refresh before Play submission.

sources.title: Schedule alarms
sources.fact: AlarmManager can operate outside the app lifetime; exact alarms require appropriate access on modern Android and setAlarmClock is the most visible critical exact mechanism.
sources.impact: Use one next one-shot alarm, request SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM contextually, check revocation and avoid polling.
sources.refresh: When target SDK or alarm policy changes.

sources.title: Android 14 behavior changes - exact alarms
sources.fact: SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM is denied by default for many fresh installs targeting Android 13+ on Android 14.
sources.impact: Treat exact access as setup state and restore permissions separately from backup.

sources.title: Android 14 behavior changes - full-screen intent
sources.fact: For target 34+, full-screen intent eligibility is restricted to calling and alarm use cases and store policy may revoke default access.
sources.impact: Use FSI only for genuine locked alarm behavior, probe eligibility and provide notification fallback.
sources.refresh: Before Play submission and target SDK update.

sources.title: Display time-sensitive notifications
sources.fact: Full-screen intents are for urgent time-sensitive cases and are delivered through notifications, not arbitrary app overlays.
sources.impact: Native alarm activity is launched by eligible notification only in locked/non-interactive path.

sources.title: About notifications
sources.fact: Android controls notification surfaces including heads-up behavior.
sources.impact: Do not promise precise heads-up height/duration; design compact content and effective channels.

sources.title: Notification runtime permission
sources.fact: Android 13+ uses POST_NOTIFICATIONS runtime permission for nonexempt notifications.
sources.impact: Request contextually and never start invisible ringing when blocked.

sources.title: Optimize for Doze and App Standby
sources.fact: Doze defers background work and imposes quotas; exact alarm use must be justified.
sources.impact: No polling; explicit exact/limited modes; bounded retries.

sources.title: Background audio hardening
sources.fact: Android 17 restricts background audio unless a visible activity or compliant foreground service exists; exact-alarm permission plus USAGE_ALARM has a documented exemption for the additional target-37 WIU condition.
sources.impact: Use bounded mediaPlayback FGS for ringing, USAGE_ALARM, visible notification and explicit stop lifecycle; test API 37 hardening.
sources.refresh: Before targeting API 37 and after QPR changes.

sources.title: Photo picker
sources.fact: Photo Picker gives access to selected images/videos instead of the whole media library and falls back to ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT where unavailable.
sources.impact: Avoid broad media permission for visual imports.

sources.title: Access documents and other files from shared storage
sources.fact: Storage Access Framework supports user-selected documents and create/open flows.
sources.impact: Use for audio/general import and ZIP export/import.

sources.title: Access app-specific files
sources.fact: Internal app-specific storage is private, needs no storage permission and is removed on uninstall.
sources.impact: Copy media into internal app storage and disclose uninstall behavior.

sources.title: Save data in a local database using Room
sources.fact: Room provides SQLite abstraction, compile-time query verification and migration support.
sources.impact: Use Room as native source of truth with migration tests.

sources.title: Setting up file sharing
sources.fact: FileProvider supports secure content URI sharing with temporary grants.
sources.impact: Share completed exports read-only without exposing internal paths.

sources.title: Back up user data with Auto Backup
sources.fact: Auto Backup can include cloud and device-to-device data; allowBackup=false alone may not disable D2D on every Android 12+ manufacturer implementation.
sources.impact: Provide dataExtractionRules and legacy exclusions for all app data; manual ZIP is the supported transfer.
sources.refresh: When target SDK or backup policy changes.

sources.title: Native Modules: Introduction
sources.fact: Turbo Native Modules and Codegen provide a typed New Architecture bridge to native platform code.
sources.impact: Define coarse-grained typed native use cases and keep alarm path native.

sources.title: Principles for improving app accessibility
sources.fact: Android accessibility guidance emphasizes labels, accessible actions, non-color cues and accessible media.
sources.impact: TalkBack/alternative action/contrast requirements are P0.

sources.title: Test your app accessibility
sources.fact: Effective accessibility testing combines approaches and user-perspective testing.
sources.impact: Manual TalkBack/task evidence supplements automated scanning.
